title: Add "Enable clipboard actions" to widget's context menu
line: The Clipboard widget's menu now has a checkable "Show Action Popup Menu When Copying" entry to turn the automatic action menu on and off.
explanation: The automatic action popup could only be toggled with a global shortcut that is unset by default, or by finding the checkbox on the Action Menu page of the settings dialog; the widget's menu only had Clear History and Configure Clipboard. This applies Tomáš's open MR plasma-workspace!6994: a checkable entry in the applet's context menu (and in the expanded popup's header menu) that toggles the setting through Klipper's existing toggle action, saves it right away, and keeps an open settings dialog in sync. The entry is only shown when some action or the built-in application action is enabled.

commits.message:
applets/clipboard: allow toggling the action popup from the context menu

Turning the automatic action popup on or off needed a global shortcut
that is unset by default or a trip to the settings dialog, so add a
checkable entry for it to the applet's menu and keep the dialog in sync.

BUG: 409803

media.caption: Master: right-clicking the Clipboard icon only offers Clear History and Configure Clipboard
Patched: the menu has a checkable "Show Action Popup Menu When Copying" entry (here turned on)
After checking it, copying a URL pops up the action menu right away
The same toggle sits behind the menu button in the expanded clipboard popup
With the settings dialog open on Action Menu, toggling updates its "When text or a file is copied" checkbox live
